props.gloss_en: the mishna: nor [may one move] second tithe [and consecrated property that were not redeemed]
it is needed only where they were redeemed but not redeemed as the law requires
second tithe -- that he redeemed on an asimon [an unminted coin]
for the Torah said 'and bind up (וצרת) the money in your hand' (Deut 14:25) -- a thing that has a form (צורה) on it
consecrated property -- that he transferred its sanctity onto land
for the Torah said 'he shall give the money and it shall be his' (Lev 27:19) [-- redemption is by money]

supports.gloss_en: דרחמנא אמר וצרת הכסף בידך, דבר שיש בו צורה -- second tithe is redeemed on something bearing a form, so an asimon does not redeem it (a verse-ground; svara stands in for דרחמנא אמר)
דרחמנא אמר ונתן הכסף וקם לו -- consecrated property is redeemed with money, so transferring it onto land does not redeem it (a verse-ground; svara stands in)
